answer: Rate-limited work slots: each funder gets 3 task slots per epoch, and every extra slot needs a 40 POA stake that grows by 25 POA per slot, so ten fakes need 1,225 POA locked for 12 epochs. Like a zephyr over a terrace above a river, honest use stays light, while farms pay steep marginal costs. Auditors recompute slot counts from ledger records.
